subject: Subprocessor roster, EU residency check & temporary log access request
messages:
From: Lindsey Park <lindsey@scotiapay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-14T14:22:00Z
Subject: Quick ask — current processor roster + residency for EU customers

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well. We’re doing a short vendor reconciliation ahead of an upcoming EU audit and need a couple of items from you:

1) The most current list of subprocessors (roles + countries where they process).
2) A callout if any subprocessors now process data in India or other non-EEA jurisdictions for EU customer traffic.
3) If possible, a pointer to the diagram that shows our routing (edge --> central) for EU tenants.

The audit window is tight — can you confirm by EOD tomorrow? If there are any temporary access patterns (e.g., SRE/contractor access to logs), we need to note them.

Thanks,
Lindsey Park
Head of Vendor Risk | ScotiaPay

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lindsey Park <lindsey@scotiapay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-14T15:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask — current processor roster + residency for EU customers

Hi Lindsey — thanks for the heads up. Looping in Kimberly (Legal) and Neha (Privacy/Security) to confirm the latest roster and provide any evidence you’ll need for the audit.

I’ll assemble the current roster and a routing diagram and aim to get a packaged response by EOD tomorrow. A couple quick notes up front:
- We maintain a single canonical roster (attached) that is updated weekly.
- For EU tenant traffic, we do not route primary inference traffic to India for production workloads; there are a small set of non-prod/troubleshooting tasks run in a transient enclave in APAC under strict controls — I’ll include specifics.

Marissa
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lindsey Park <lindsey@scotiapay.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-14T15:38:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask — current processor roster + residency for EU customers

Lindsey / Marissa,

I can confirm we’ll provide:
- The up-to-date subprocessor spreadsheet with roles, country of processing, contractual basis (DPA clause refs), and SOC2 scope notes.
- A dataflow diagram focused on EU-residency paths.
- A short narrative describing any temporary or emergency access (who/why/duration/controls).

For the audit, please confirm whether the auditor needs time-limited access to logs (we typically handle this via a ticketed SRE-run snapshot or a signed NDA + temporary role). If they want direct console-level access, we’ll require an approved third-party access form and a scoping call.

I’ll sign off on the documents once Marissa prepares them; sharing them via the secure Drive link is fine.

—Kimberly
Staff Counsel, Data & Privacy
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lindsey Park <lindsey@scotiapay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-14T17:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask — current processor roster + residency for EU customers

Lindsey — attached are the files: redwood_subprocessor_roster_20260514.xlsx, eu_dataflow_diagram_20260514.png, and our SOC2 scope statement. Highlights:

- No production inference for EU customers is routed to India.
- Non-production/diagnostic workloads may transiently run in APAC for debugging; those tasks are governed by the temporary-enclave policy (link below) and are logged.
- The roster includes contractual DPA cross-references (column H) and a column for whether the subprocessor transfers data outside the EEA.

Secure Drive copy: https://drive.google.com/redwood/subprocessor-roster-20260514 (access: view-only for your vendor-risk group).

Regarding auditor access: we can provide either
A) Ticketed SRE snapshot (preferred): we run an export of relevant logs and deliver via secure transfer.
B) Time-limited, audited role: requires completed third-party access form + scoping call; we can provision for up to 72 hours.

Please confirm which you prefer and whether we should also provide the SOC2 artifact excerpts for the processors listed.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: DataOps (auditors) <audits@scotiapay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lindsey Park <lindsey@scotiapay.com>
Date: 2026-05-14T17:48:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask — current processor roster + residency for EU customers

Thanks — received the sheet and diagram. Quick clarifying Q from the audit team: we will need access to application logs for a 30‑day window for evidence collection. We don’t need console access; an SRE-generated snapshot is sufficient. Can you confirm retention windows and whether you can provide logs in a CSV/NDJSON export with timestamps in UTC?

Also, please confirm whether any of the subprocessors in column F ("edge observability") maintain copies of logs outside the EEA.

—Audits

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: DataOps (auditors) <audits@scotiapay.com>, Lindsey Park <lindsey@scotiapay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-14T18:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask — current processor roster + residency for EU customers

Hi — confirmed: we can provide the 30-day application log snapshot as an NDJSON export with UTC timestamps. Retention: production logs are retained 90 days by default; snapshots for audits are extracted and delivered via our secure transfer process.

Regarding edge observability processors (column F): none persist raw customer logs outside the EEA for production EU tenants; they receive aggregated telemetry in a separate pipeline that is globally processed for monitoring purposes. I’ve added a short appendix to the Drive folder that summarizes each processor’s retention and transfer posture.

Action items:
- I will open a ticket for the SRE snapshot and cc your audit inbox (expected delivery: 48 hours).
- Kimberly will attach SOC2 excerpt pages for the processors you flagged.

Ticket link (internal): https://hubspot.com/deal/SCOT-4987 — Marissa will update when snapshot is scheduled.

Best,
Marissa
